title: Four clauses from a linear constraint
statement: Given an E3-Lin constraint over $\mathbb{F}_2$ on three distinct variables, associate the multiset of four E3-Sat clauses obtained by applying the four-clause replacement, one clause for each of the four indices in $\{0,1,2,3\}$.
caveat: The exact signs of the four clauses depend on the omitted definition of the clause-sign function.
